question: Which organic chemist from Pakistan was awarded China's 2019 ‘International Science and Technology Cooperation Award’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atta-ur-Rahman**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Atta-ur-Rahman** was awarded China's 2019 ‘International Science and Technology Cooperation Award’.
 
• He was given the award by **President Xi Jinping.**
 
• He was also awarded the prestigious “**Einstein Professorship**” by the Chinese Academy
